buildCommand: bash -c 'ROOT=$(pwd); if [ ! -d backend ] && [ -d ../backend ]; then cd ..; ROOT=$(pwd); fi; cd $ROOT && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix landing-page-black && npm run build --prefix landing-page-black && if [ ! -d landing-page-black/dist ]; then echo "ERROR: dist directory not found at $ROOT/landing-page-black/dist" && exit 1; fi'
